# Limits

<!-- Generated by `node scripts/generate-limits.mjs` from `limits.ts`,
     `shares.ts`, `projectionWorker.ts`, `publishValidation.ts` and
     `compose.yaml`. Do not edit by hand; `--check` fails when this file is
     stale. -->

What one Suite instance accepts, and what happens at the boundary. The numbers
below are read from the code that enforces them, so they cannot drift from the
behaviour. Two surfaces enforce them: the relay (`apps/collab-server`) and the
publish validator (`packages/graph`).

## Workspaces and storage

| Quota | Variable | Self-host | Hosted (`SUITE_HOSTED=1`) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Workspaces per licence or instance | `SUITE_MAX_WORKSPACES` | unlimited | unlimited |
| Document bytes per workspace | `SUITE_DOCUMENT_BYTES_PER_WORKSPACE` | unlimited | unlimited |
| Projection bytes per workspace | `SUITE_PROJECTION_BYTES_PER_WORKSPACE` | unlimited | 32 MiB (33,554,432 bytes) |
| Attachment bytes per workspace | `SUITE_ATTACHMENT_BYTES_PER_WORKSPACE` | unlimited | unlimited |

A hosted licence carries its own `workspaces`, `documentBytes` and
`attachmentBytes`; the tighter of the licence and the instance value wins.
Self-hosting has no licence, so the storage quotas are unlimited unless you set
one. `unlimited` is also accepted as a value for every quota.

## Links, cards and selection

| Cap | Variable | Value | Where it is enforced |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Active share links per workspace | `SUITE_MAX_SHARES_PER_WORKSPACE` | 100 | Creating a link; existing links keep resolving |
| Cards in one selection share | `SUITE_MAX_SELECTION_CARDS` / `MAX_SELECTION_CARDS` | 200 | `createShareQuotaGuard`, `shares.ts` |
| Cards per workspace | — | no cap | Bounded by document bytes |
| Cards in one selection on the canvas | — | no cap | Bounded by what the browser can hold |

## Publish caps

A draft is written by a browser that any client can run, so the publisher
re-checks these on the projected plan. They are constants in
`packages/graph/src/publishValidation.ts`; only the two byte caps have an
environment override.

| Cap | Variable | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Text bytes per card (title and body) | `SUITE_PUBLISH_MAX_CARD_TEXT_BYTES` | 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes) |
| Bytes in one published draft | `SUITE_PUBLISH_MAX_DRAFT_BYTES` | 20 MiB (20,971,520 bytes) |
| Largest absolute coordinate, size or z-order | — | 10,000,000 |
| Deepest rich-text nesting | — | 64 |
| Section title bytes | — | 1,000 bytes |
| Edge label bytes | — | 500 bytes |

## Concurrency

| Limit | Variable | Value | Behaviour at the limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Open projection rooms | `SUITE_PROJECTION_ROOMS_MAX` | 128 | The least-recently-used room with no connected client is closed and re-opens on demand. |
| Peers per room | — | no cap | Every session in a room shares one process and one document; RAM is the real ceiling. |
| Live rooms | — | no cap | A room lives while a client is connected; the process is single-replica by design. |

## Disk watermarks

| Watermark | Variable | Self-host | Hosted (`SUITE_HOSTED=1`) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Document store size that logs a warning | `SUITE_DISK_SOFT_BYTES` | unlimited | 4 GiB (4,294,967,296 bytes) |
| Document store size that refuses new workspaces | `SUITE_DISK_HARD_BYTES` | unlimited | 5 GiB (5,368,709,120 bytes) |

A workspace that already exists keeps saving past the hard watermark; only a
new workspace is refused. Nothing is deleted to make room.

## Restore targets

`compose.yaml` keeps the stores on the named volume `suite-data`,
mounted at `/data` in the `app` container. A backup or restore
target is that volume, not an individual file: owner hashes, share rows and
documents refer to each other.

| Store | Variable | Path in the container | Survives a container recreate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Documents | `SUITE_DB` | `/data/documents.sqlite` | yes |
| Share links | `SUITE_SHARES_DB` | `/data/shares.sqlite` | yes |
| Workspaces | `SUITE_WORKSPACES_DB` | `/data/workspaces.sqlite` | yes |
| Settings | `SUITE_SETTINGS_DB` | `:memory:` (inside the process) | **no** |
| Licence claims | `SUITE_LICENCE_DB` | `:memory:` (inside the process) | **no** |
| Attachments | `SUITE_ATTACHMENTS_DB` | not set in `compose.yaml`; defaults to `suite.attachments.sqlite` in the process working directory | **no** |

Backup and restore use `deploy/backup.sh` and `deploy/restore.sh`; the
procedure is in [operations.md](./operations.md#back-it-up) and
[release.md](./release.md).

## At the boundary

- A save is never dropped. A workspace over its document budget keeps loading
  and saving for its owner; what it loses is the ability to mint new share links.
- Only the places where nothing has been written yet are refused: a new
  workspace, a new share link, an oversized attachment, an oversized publish.
- Every refusal names the limit, the current value and the variable that sets
  it, so an operator can answer "why" without reading the code.
- The server validates every quota at boot: a value it cannot read is a startup
  error naming the variable, not a silent fallback.
